stem.text: A school has a piece of aluminium that it uses for radioactivity experiments. Its thickness is marked as $3.2\,\text{mm}$. A student decides to check this value. He has vernier calipers which give measurements to $0.1\,\text{mm}$ and a micrometer which gives measurements to $0.01\,\text{mm}$.

A.text: The micrometer gives a more accurate measurement.

B.text: The micrometer gives a more precise measurement.

C.text: The vernier calipers give a more accurate measurement.

D.text: The vernier calipers give a more precise measurement.
